question: If M is N's sister, O is N's wife, Q is the father of N, and P is the daughter of Q, then what is the relation between M and P?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

**Explanation :**

1) M is N's sister

2) O is N's wife

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e28fbefd38d9e4a911ceb334b03d4fccf7e4555753f0b976df431fb42a2b51c.png] 

3) Q is the father of N

4) P is the daughter of Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/745dfaa846c40995d934a4374100d88eb03fbd57a6266a5d6cb3afb1e748ed5e.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree M and P are sisters.

Hence, the correct answer is "Sisters".
